newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Jan-May 1997 industrial production rises.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Jan-May 1997 industrial production rises.

text.p: Mexico's Finance Ministry released the following seasonally adjusted data on industrial production for May:

May mining including petroleum rose 6.2 percent, manufacturing industry rose 8.7, construction rose 13 percent and electricity generation, gas and water rose 4.8 percent compared to the same month last year.
Cumulative January to May figures showed mining production including petroleum rose 3.2 percent compared to the same period a year earlier.

Construction rose 11.0 percent over the same period, manufacturing industry climbed 8.7 percent and the generation of electricity, gas and water rose 5.4 percent in the first five months. ((--Caroline Brothers, Mexico City newsroom 525 728 7905))
